theme: plate ACL CANREAD/CANWRITE/CANEXEC + OWNERNAME/GROUPNAME admit gate

weaknesses.title: CAN* vs OWNERNAME soft-fail models disagree
weaknesses.detail: CANREAD missing path → OK=1 LAST_N=0 (probe). OWNERNAME missing → OK=0 sticky LAST_ERR. Agents cannot uniform-handle admit vs label soft misses.

weaknesses.title: No single CAN_RWX / ACCESSMASK form
weaknesses.detail: Three separate probes required for r/w/x. Gate boards hand-roll HAS letter parse on want string — fragile and verbose.

weaknesses.title: MODE string vs MODE_N decimal dual confuses agents
weaknesses.detail: 0644 string but MODE_N=420 (decimal). Agents comparing MODE_N==644 fail silently.

weaknesses.title: Gate letter parse via HAS is substring-false-friend prone
weaknesses.detail: HAS want "r" works for rwx but would match accidental bags containing letter r. No CHARHAS / SET-of-flags helper.

weaknesses.title: No MINE/ISOWNERNAME helper — dual OWNEDBY + OWNERNAME EQS USER
weaknesses.detail: OWNEDBY is euid; OWNERNAME is login string. Agents must dual-probe to stamp audit+admit. Race if passwd entry missing → numeric fallback name.

weaknesses.title: WRITE metas omit trailing NL
weaknesses.detail: ACTIVE.txt path and VAL glue in cat -A without $ line ends on short writes.

weaknesses.title: CANEXEC=0 on ordinary data plates surprises agents
weaknesses.detail: Default put body is not +x; agents requiring rwx gate fail on secrets/env plates. Docs should separate data vs runbook gates.

weaknesses.title: Non-numeric REQUIRE softens
weaknesses.detail: CUBALC_PA_REQUIRE=abc leaves REQUIRE_HIT=0 so gate deny stays rc 0.

workarounds: Treat CAN* LAST_N as admit bit; OWNERNAME OK as soft exist
Prefer MODE string for display; MODE_N only for bit math
Dual-probe OWNEDBY + OWNERNAME for mine stamps
Use gate=rw for data plates; gate=rx for runbooks
language_gaps: Unified soft-probe contract for access vs name ops
SYS ACCESSMASK or CAN_RWX bag form
MODE_N octal-string dual docs / MODE_OCT helper
CHARHAS / flag-set parse for rwx wants
issues_faced: CAN* missing is OK=1; OWNERNAME missing is OK=0 — core lesson
MODE_N=420 for 0644 documented as agent trap
selftest 253/253; no language fix this iter
